items.title: AI Agents Are Creating a New Layer of Cybersecurity Spending
items.summary: Akamai launched a locked box for AI agents on Tuesday. It joins Palo Alto, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Okta and Zscaler in selling protection for software that now acts on its own.
items.titleZh: 人工智能代理正在创造新的网络安全支出
items.summaryZh: Akamai周二为AI代理推出了一个带锁的盒子。它加入了Palo Alto、思科、CrowdStrike、Okta和Zscaler的行列，为现在独立运作的软件提供保护。

items.title: Ex-Google engineer Nate Soares hasn’t added to his 401(k) in a decade because he’s an ‘AI kills all humans guy’
items.summary: The coauthor of “If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies” puts the odds that humanity doesn’t have 10 years left at better than even.
items.titleZh: 前谷歌工程师Nate Soares十年来没有增加他的401（k），因为他是一个“人工智能杀死所有人类的人”
items.summaryZh: 《如果有人建造它，每个人都会死》的合著者认为，人类剩下的10年时间已经不比现在好了。

items.title: Why this new Fitbit feature takes us one step closer to non-invasive glucose tracking
items.summary: Insulin resistance and blood pressure trends are now available on two new Fitbit devices.
items.titleZh: 为什么Fitbit的这一新功能使我们更接近非侵入性葡萄糖追踪
items.summaryZh: 胰岛素抵抗和血压趋势现在可以在两款新的Fitbit设备上使用。

items.title: Margin debt growth slows sharply as stock market warning signs build
items.summary: Slowing margin-debt growth could signal growing risks for stocks.
items.titleZh: 随着股市警告信号的建立，保证金债务增长急剧放缓
items.summaryZh: 保证金债务增长放缓可能预示着股市风险增加。

items.title: Anthropic Flags Gas Supply as One of Its Biggest Near-Term Risks
items.summary: The data center buildout could cause a massive increase in gas prices as companies scramble for limited supplies and infrastructure fails to meet demand.
items.titleZh: Anthropic将天然气供应视为其近期最大的风险之一
items.summaryZh: 数据中心的扩建可能会导致天然气价格大幅上涨，因为公司争夺有限的供应，基础设施无法满足需求。

items.title: About 70% of tax scholars would vote against California’s billionaire tax, a new survey finds
items.summary: Economists and accountants overwhelmingly oppose Prop. 40, while law professors lean yes, according to a UNC professor’s poll of 105 tax academics.
items.titleZh: 一项新的调查发现，约70%的税务学者将投票反对加州的亿万富翁税
items.summaryZh: 经济学家和会计师压倒性地反对该提案。根据北卡罗来纳大学一位教授对105名税务学者的民意调查，40人支持，而法学教授则倾向于支持。

items.title: UK Home Office May Face Investigation Over Use of OpenAI Tools
items.summary: A government watchdog is considering a probe into the Home Office’s use of ChatGPT technology to process asylum claims amid concerns over the tools’ accuracy and secrecy surrounding their use.
items.titleZh: 英国内政部可能因使用OpenAI工具而面临调查
items.summaryZh: 一家政府监管机构正在考虑对内政部使用ChatGPT技术处理庇护申请进行调查，因为人们担心这些工具的准确性和使用保密性。
